around.headline: Bengaluru man returns from a movie to a ransacked house and is attacked by robbers
around.summary: Times of India reports the man was attacked after walking in on the robbers. If a door or lock looks tampered with when you return, stay outside and call 112 rather than going in alone.

around.headline: Man stages own kidnapping to extort Rs 90 lakh from his father
around.summary: Reports say the Bengaluru man faked his abduction to clear a debt. Ransom calls can be staged, so reach the person directly on another phone and call 112 before paying.
around.source: Deccan Herald, The New Indian Express

around.headline: Fake PAN card used in a private firm officer's name; fake Louis Vuitton goods sold at Whitefield store
around.summary: Two separate fraud cases were reported in the city. Check your PAN-linked records on the income tax portal and buy branded goods only from authorised stores.

around.headline: Namma Metro runs beyond midnight tonight; overnight rain had waterlogged roads
around.summary: BMRCL extended timings for October 3, while overnight rain disrupted this morning's traffic. Check the last-train time in the Namma Metro app before a late return.

around.headline: Bengaluru–Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper set to start this month
around.summary: The Hindu and Times of India report it will be India's second sleeper train, with two halts in Andhra Pradesh. Wait for the official timetable and fares before booking.

around.headline: Residents of Haralur and Kasavanahalli protest over roads and civic woes; Indiranagar footpaths repaired after viral post
around.summary: Residents took to the streets over poor road infrastructure, while Indiranagar's broken pavements were fixed quickly after a viral post. Reporting issues with photos on the BBMP grievance channels can speed up action.
around.source: Deccan Herald, The Times of India

around.summary: Times of India reports the arrest in a large homebuyer fraud case. Before paying a builder, check the project's registration on the Karnataka RERA website.

street_smart.title: You get home after a late movie and find your front door unlocked, the lock scratched, and a light on inside that you didn't leave on. You hear movement. What do you do?
street_smart.based_on: Times of India, Oct 3: Back from movie, Bengaluru man finds house ransacked and gets attacked by robbers.
street_smart.situation: You are alone at the door of your flat, it is late, and neighbours' lights are mostly off.

choices.text: Step in quickly to see what's missing and confront whoever is inside.
choices.feedback: Intruders who are cornered inside become dangerous, and this is how people get attacked. Things can be replaced; you can't, and you may also disturb evidence.

choices.text: Move away from the door to a safe spot, call 112, and wait for police and neighbours before entering.
choices.feedback: Distance keeps you safe, 112 dispatches police to your location, and an untouched scene helps them find fingerprints and CCTV leads.

choices.text: Shout 'Who's there?' loudly from the doorway and wait to see who comes out.
choices.feedback: It warns the intruders but keeps you right at the exit they will use, so you could be shoved or attacked.

choices.text: Go in just to grab your valuables and then call the police.
choices.feedback: The few minutes inside are the most dangerous ones, and you may contaminate the scene before police see it.

takeaways: Stay out and call 112 the moment a lock or door looks tampered with.
Don't touch anything inside until police arrive, so fingerprints and evidence survive.
Tell a neighbour or relative when you'll be out late, and use a door camera or smart lock alert if you can.

quiz.question: The Bengaluru–Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper will halt at two stations in which state?
quiz.why: It is reported to be India's second sleeper Vande Bharat, so check the official halts and timetable before booking.

quiz.question: In how many crores is the homebuyer fraud for which ED arrested the Ozone Urbana chief?
quiz.why: Checking a project's RERA registration before paying any builder is the simplest protection.

quiz.question: How many barrels of oil did the G7 nations agree to release, according to The Hindu?
quiz.why: Releases from strategic reserves are used to ease supply and fuel price pressure, which can eventually affect petrol and diesel costs in India.

quiz.question: Which river, flowing through Karnataka, is often called the 'Dakshina Ganga'?
quiz.why: The Kaveri rises in Kodagu at Talakaveri and is Bengaluru's main drinking-water source.

quiz.question: Which emergency number connects you to police, fire and ambulance across India?
quiz.why: 112 is the single national emergency number, while 1930 is the cyber fraud helpline.
